introduction:
The Ration Card in Madhya Pradesh is managed by the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. It ensures the distribution of subsidized or free food grains through the Public Distribution System (PDS) under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).

In Madhya Pradesh, the entire Ration Card ecosystem is deeply integrated with the Samagra Samajik Suraksha Mission (SSSM). Possessing an active Samagra ID for your family and individual members is mandatory to apply for, receive, and manage your Ration Card.

Before You Start (Pre-Check List)
  • Samagra IDs: Ensure you have your active 8-digit Family Samagra ID and 9-digit Member Samagra IDs.
  • Aadhaar e-KYC: Every member's Aadhaar must be linked to their Samagra ID (do this at samagra.gov.in).
  • Exact Details Match: The name spelling, gender, and date of birth on the Aadhaar card must exactly match the Samagra database. Even a single-character mismatch will lead to automatic rejection.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts
  • Service: Application for a new Ration Card online (2026 process).
  • Cost: Completely Free.
  • Portal Used: National Food Security Portal (NFSA)
  • Authentication Method: Aadhaar OTP-based login and submission.
  • Important Requirement: The applicant's Aadhaar card must be linked to an active mobile number to receive OTPs.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for MP Ration Card

Note: All documents must be uploaded digitally in PDF, JPG, or PNG format. The maximum file size for general documents is 200 KB, while NFSA criteria documents require a maximum size of 20 KB.
For Applicant & Family Members
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card (Highly recommended), Voter ID, PAN Card, etc.
  • Address Proof: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Home Tax Receipt, etc.
Additional/Optional Documents
  • Caste Certificate (Mandatory if applying under OBC, SC, or ST categories)
  • House Ownership Proof (Property Tax Receipt, Registry, or Rent Agreement)
  • Bank Passbook (for entering bank details)
  • Gas Connection Book / Electricity Bill
  • MNREGA Job Card (If applicable)
  • Disability/Medical Certificates (If any family member has a physical disability or critical illness)
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via NFSA

Step 1: Portal Login
  1. Visit the official NFSA portal (nfsa.gov.in).
  2. Click on "Sign In / Register" at the top right and select "Public Login".
  3. Choose the "Sign in with Aadhaar OTP" option. Enter your Aadhaar number, and captcha, and click "Get OTP".
  4. Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and click "Use OTP" to log into your dashboard. (Note: If your Aadhaar is not linked to a mobile number, you must create a New User ID and Password).
Step 2: Start New Registration
  1. On the left-side menu, click on "Common Registration Facility" and select "New Registration".
  2. Select your State from the dropdown menu and click "Submit".
Step 3: Fill Application Steps (7 Stages)
  1. General Details: Select the scheme (e.g., Antyodaya Anna Yojana for BPL, Priority Household). Enter the applicant's personal details (Name in English and local language, DOB, Parents' names, Marital Status, Occupation, Annual Income, and Aadhaar Number). Click "Save and Continue".
  2. Address Details: Fill in your complete Present Address and Permanent Address. If both are the same, tick the checkbox. Click "Save and Continue".
  3. Additional Info: Select your Caste Category (upload the certificate if non-General). Fill in details about your House Type, Gas Connection, Bank Account, Electricity Connection, and any physical disabilities or critical illnesses.
  4. RC Member(s): Click on "Add Member" to add your family members. You must fill out their personal details, and Aadhaar numbers, and upload both an Identity Proof and an Address Proof for each member. Save each member.
  5. RC Enclosures: Upload the Identity Proof and Address Proof for the main applicant (Head of Family).
  6. NFSA Criteria: Select your house ownership status (Own/Rent) and upload the supporting document (Max 20 KB).
  7. Finish: Select your nearest "Home Fair Price Shop" (Ration Dealer) based on your address. Check the "Consent of data use" declaration box and click "Save".
Step 4: Final Submission
  • After clicking save, a final OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Enter this OTP to submit the form.
  • A Reference ID will be generated. Note this down for tracking purposes.
Step 5: Offline Visit Required
  • Once your application is approved and the Ration Card is issued online, you and your family members must visit the selected Fair Price Shop (Ration Dealer).
  • You will need to complete Biometric Authentication (e-KYC) via a fingerprint scanner at the shop. Only after this offline verification will you begin receiving food grains.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

Note: Below is the standard government procedure for applying offline for a new Ration Card.
  1. Visit your local Food and Civil Supplies Office, Tehsil/Taluka Office, or Gram Panchayat / Ward Office.
  2. Request the "Form for New Ration Card".
  3. Fill out the application form with the details of the Head of the Family and all family members.
  4. Attach photocopies of all required documents (Aadhaar cards of all members, income certificate, address proof, passport-size photographs of the Head of the Family, bank passbook, and gas connection passbook).
  5. Submit the filled form and documents to the Food and Supply Officer (FSO) or the designated clerk at the counter.
  6. Collect your acknowledgment slip. A field verification officer may visit your residential address to verify the details before the card is approved and printed.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Tracking Status

You can check the status of your application at any time through the NFSA portal:

  • Log in and go to "Common Registration Facility" -> "Registration Status".
  • Enter your Reference Number. The dashboard will show if your application is in Draft, Pending for Approval, Approved, or Rejected.
  • If rejected, the portal will display the exact reason for the rejection so you can correct it.
